title: The Save Pelé Never Forgot
coreQuestion: Why is Gordon Banks's save from Pelé in 1970 still studied?

facts.source: Brazil at the 1970 FIFA World Cup
facts.claim: Gordon Banks saved a header from Pelé in Brazil's group match against England.
Pelé described it as one of the best saves he had ever seen.

facts.source: Brazil at the 1970 FIFA World Cup
facts.claim: Jairzinho scored the winning goal for Brazil against England.
Brazil won the tournament, beating Italy in the final.

narration.text: Pelé's header looked like a goal. Then it wasn't.
The 1970 World Cup. Brazil against England.
Pelé met the cross with a header.
Gordon Banks got across and kept it out.
Pelé later called it one of the best saves he had ever seen.
And they went on to win the whole tournament. Every goal has a story.
